payout_quote: The member making the referral (Referrer) will earn a $50 Mastercard Digital Reward Card (Reward Card) for each individual referred (Referred Person) to Everwise Credit Union who registers for the offer via ReferLive, opens a new Everwise Credit Union Checking Account, and completes the offer requirements within the time specified.
steps: Be an Everwise Credit Union member, 18 or older.
Register at everwisecu.com/refer to get your unique referral link; share it by email, text, or social media.
Your friend registers via your link and opens a new Everwise Checking Account (Simply, Plus, or Max).
Your friend completes at least one of: enrolls in eStatements through mobile/online banking, OR makes at least one direct deposit totaling $500+ within 60 days of account opening.
Your $50 Mastercard Digital Reward Card arrives typically within 2-3 weeks after all requirements are met.
catches: The $50 is a Mastercard Digital Reward Card (valid 6 months from issuance, usable online/mail/phone where Mastercard debit is accepted) - not cash.
Cap: $500 in referral rewards per calendar year (10 referrals).
Friend must be genuinely new: no banking relationship with Everwise in the last 12 months.
Both parties must have open membership in good standing when rewards are paid.
Business, organizational, and commercial accounts cannot participate; Everwise employees ineligible.
Reward Cards may be reported as income to the IRS.
Terms and conditions may change at any time without notice; Everwise reserves the right to refuse payment in its sole discretion.
biggest_catch: Your $50 comes as a digital Mastercard valid for only 6 months - and your friend must be a true newcomer (no Everwise relationship in 12 months) who enrolls in eStatements or drops $500+ in direct deposits.
eligibility: Everwise CU members 18+; friends/family 18+ who are new to Everwise (no banking relationship in last 12 months). Indiana/Michigan borrowers for loans; terms page notes IN/MI residency context for lending.
timing: Digital reward cards typically arrive within 2-3 weeks after all requirements are met.
